#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int n;
int S;
int cnt[250], id[250];
int f[10][250];
vector<int> vec[10];
map<pair<int, long long>, int> mp;

int power(int base, int exp) {
    int result = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (long long)result * base % MOD;
        base = (long long)base * base % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int DP(int x, long long state) {
    if (state == 0) return 0;
    if (x == n) return 1;
    auto key = make_pair(x, state);
    if (mp.count(key)) return mp[key];

    S++;
    int answer = 0;
    for (int j = 1; j <= (1 << n) - 1; ++j) {
        long long next_state = 0;
        for (size_t k = 0; k < vec[x].size(); ++k) {
            if (!(state & (1LL << k))) continue;
            int las = vec[x][k];
            for (int l = 0; l < n; ++l) {
                if ((j & (1 << l)) && !(las & (1 << l))) {
                    next_state |= 1LL << id[las | (1 << l)];
                }
            }
        }
        answer = (answer + (long long)f[x][j] * DP(x + 1, next_state)) % MOD;
    }
    mp[key] = answer;
    return answer;
}

int main() {
    cin >> n;
    int inv100 = power(100, MOD - 2);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        f[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            int P;
            cin >> P;
            int p1 = (long long)P * inv100 % MOD;
            int p0 = (MOD + 1 - p1) % MOD;
            for (int k = 0; k < (1 << j); ++k) {
                f[i][k | (1 << j)] = (long long)f[i][k] * p1 % MOD;
                f[i][k] = (long long)f[i][k] * p0 % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); ++i) {
        cnt[i] = __builtin_popcount(i);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); ++i) {
        vec[cnt[i]].push_back(i);
        id[i] = (int)vec[cnt[i]].size() - 1;
    }
    cout << DP(0, 1LL) << "\n";
    return 0;
}
